violations.text: Single-Use Utensils were observed stored with food contact surfaces up or laying in a utensils divider tray with the handles and lip surfaces facing in opposite directions. Utensils are to be stored so that only the handles are touched by employees and consumers if consumer self-service is provided. New Violation. Correct By: 05/20/2026

The pressure measuring gauge to the high temp dish machine was not observed to be at 15-25 psi during the rinse cycle as required. (Dish machine was observed to be properly sanitizing per the thermo-label used at time of inspection.) Pressure gauge is to be repaired or replaced. New Violation. Correct By: 06/03/2026
